title: CAE included on TIME’s list of the World’s Best Companies 2026
summary: This prestigious award is presented by TIME and Statista Inc., the statistics portal and industry ranking provider.
body_markdown:
CAE has been included in the first edition of the World’s Best Companies 2026.


This prestigious award is presented by TIME and Statista Inc., the statistics portal and industry ranking provider. The award list was announced on Sept. 9, 2026, and can be viewed on[Time.com](https://u21217919.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.hNOgNytL2Sfk7BB3MrSk5QGVDKVX3KcWRBuh3K80KP1RGLi0C6GFCdCak346t7dnhuCRRjhCanYyyR4C-2BNt4SKnGFc4dhepaIO23Dkw-2BFps3S6UZNRdcYZCY4QNXClNfV1xtibzb4vVDfWNWpsDUcIZ4sbyRksYiN8-2Bu7YdddWPSjPByskb7vr3LKx7ZAs6dNm5XgkXAZWqosAH41LknTthFEaL1vtLmFrNbSBRg4g4-3DJyt6_3Njj853Hxr120e7qWk68ZduavrXYSitVigtztRuqKEvV5yvINlVHAZ-2FSXAgJT67uEjHRrMP6UNPUy3WweOv65ieGCzLNzHa69j2lLvJMAU8Bb8mi1g0WA7qbVQsRrcE9SEtBsLXuwR1Sp36Lzk5ESx3KrFfp1rcRXWSAD7YEyto3ugkZmOLpEQ0HGYCh4ZO6ew8A9xi-2BTnpMkZgCGKAwSQ-3D-3D) .


The World’s Best Companies 2026 ranking highlights leading global organizations that exemplify excellence in today’s corporate landscape.


Companies were evaluated using three primary data sources: Employee Satisfaction, Revenue Growth, and Sustainability Transparency. Out of hundreds of thousands of data points assessed, the top 1,000 companies were recognized for outstanding performance across these key areas.


Based on the results of the study, CAE is honored to be recognized on TIME’s list of the World’s Best Companies 2026.


Statista publishes hundreds of worldwide industry rankings and company listings with high-profile media partners.


This research and analysis service is based on the success of statista.com, the leading data and business intelligence portal that provides statistics, relevant business data, and various market and consumer studies and surveys.


“This recognition belongs to the exceptional people of CAE. Their expertise, discipline and commitment to excellence are what set us apart. We are proud of what we have built and confident in what comes next as we continue to build a stronger CAE,” said Matthew Bromberg, president and chief executive officer of CAE.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by CAE.*
